mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, name, role, department_id, is_active) VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, #{role}, #{departmentId}, #{isActive})
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS id, u.email AS email, u.name AS name, u.role AS role, u.department_id AS departmentId, d.name AS departmentName, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.is_active AS active, u.created_at AS createdAt FROM users u LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = u.department_id WHERE u.id = #{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = #{email})

SELECT count(*) FROM users
(name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR email ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET name = #{name}, role = #{role}, department_id = #{departmentId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET is_active = false, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
